insights.question: What pick/ban tendencies repeat most?
insights.title: Teams respect-ban Yone against them
insights.text: Opponents banned Yone against them in 58/113 games (51%).

insights.question: What pick/ban tendencies repeat most?
insights.title: Azir is always on their mind
insights.text: They pick or ban Azir in 43/113 games (38%): 17 picks (12-5) and 26 bans.

insights.question: How does the draft shift in Fearless G2/G3+?
insights.title: No Xin Zhao? They go Sejuani
insights.text: Xin Zhao is a G1 favorite (12/42 G1s, played by Peanut). In the 51 later games where it was burned or banned, Peanut went to Sejuani (10/51) and Nidalee (6/51).

insights.question: How does the draft shift in Fearless G2/G3+?
insights.title: In G3+ they go about as deep as the league
insights.text: In 29 G3+ games, 38/145 picks (26%) were champions they never played in any G1 (league 31%). Pool: 57 champs in G1s, 67 in G3+.

insights.question: How does the draft shift in Fearless G2/G3+?
insights.title: They fade once their pool is burned
